newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian forex market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian forex market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Malaysian foreign exchange market is closed on Thursday for a Moslem religious holiday.
On Wednesday, the ringgit weakened against the dollar in late trading on selling orders out of London.
Bank Negara was said to have checked rates at around 2.5700, dealers said.
The ringgit was quoted at 2.5745/95 a dollar at 1000 GMT on Wednesday against 2.5580/10 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Tuesday.
On Thursday at 0143 GMT, it was quoted at 2.5860/90.
